name: Olympus µ
note: the original 1991 mju-1 under its bare symbol name — same camera as the Infinity Stylus record (US primary, intl twin 'Olympus Mju-I' already recorded). Three records shipped for one camera.

name: Olympus Mju-1
note: as above — the third spelling of the same 1991 body. The 1992 'Olympus Mju-1 Limited' is a genuinely separate commemorative model and stays.

name: Stylus 410
note: brandless duplicate of the digital Stylus 410.

name: Olympus Mju-II zoom 80 Deluxe Edition
note: no primary source supports a standalone international 'Deluxe Edition' SKU — 'Deluxe'/'DLX' is a US trim (Quartzdate/panorama, often the VF revision) of the same mju-II Zoom 80. Trim names ride as aliases on the survivor.

name: Olympus Mju-II Zoom 115 Deluxe Edition
note: as above — trim, not a separate body.

name: Olympus Stylus Epic Zoom 115 Deluxe
note: US trim-name record for the same camera, third copy of the 115.

name: Olympus Mju-III 115
note: the mju-III line launched 2002-2003; the shipped 1997 is the original mju-II's launch year misattached.

name: Olympus Mju-II Zoom 80
note: US Deluxe/DLX trim spellings of the same camera.

name: Olympus µ-II ZOOM 170
note: Latin spelling of the µ record name plus the US market name and its Deluxe/DLX trim spellings — the market-names row for this pair had never connected because of the missing 'Zoom' token.
